study_design.purpose: Controlled architecture comparison on identical frozen SigLIP embeddings and identical processed Polyvore examples.
study_design.scope_warning: These are architecture-family baselines adapted to this project's four-slot tensors, not exact reproductions of published systems. Published benchmark numbers are not directly comparable.
